answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after a probationary season of useful, peer-reviewed work — a falcon must prove itself before it may hunt at the zenith of the flock. A Sybil attacker cloning identities has to fund a separate stake per clone and wait out the same slow probation, while a sudden gale of fresh accounts with no work history earns neither trust nor payout. Clones stay expensive, slow, and easy to spot in bulk.
